## Intended function

GP13 backlight open-drain stage (#41): N-channel logic-level MOSFET between the module's LCD_BL / CAT1 EN node and GND so the RP2040 pad never sees the module's 10k pull-up to VSYS

## Recorded findings

Generic record with NO manufacturer part, LCSC code or footprint: the numbers below are this design's requirements for the part to be selected at G08, not a datasheet of a chosen device. Pin numbers 1/2/3 are logical (GATE/SOURCE/DRAIN) and do not assert any package pinout; the exact part's pin assignment is applied when its footprint is drawn.

Requirement: logic-level gate. Vgs(th) maximum well below the RP2040 minimum V_OH at IOVDD 3.3 V, and a datasheet Rds(on) specification at Vgs = 2.5 V (or lower) so the on-state is guaranteed from a 3.3 V GPIO with margin, not inferred from a 4.5 V / 10 V curve.

Requirement: Vds rating &gt;= 20 V (drain sits at the module's VSYS, USB 4.75-5.25 V, when off); Vgs rating &gt;= +/-8 V; continuous Id &gt;= 10 mA. The on-state current is only (VSYS / module R16 10k) &lt;= 0.53 mA, so dissipation is negligible; Rds(on) &lt;= 10 ohm at Vgs = 2.5 V keeps the on-state LCD_BL node below 10 mV.

Requirement: gate leakage Igss &lt;= 1 uA at the rated Vgs, so the 100k gate pull-down (R88) holds the gate below 0.1 V when GP13 is undriven.

Behaviour on the carrier (design/evidence/backlight-interface.md): gate low (reset, BOOTSEL, undriven, or GP13 driven low) = MOSFET off = LCD_BL pulled to VSYS by module R16 = backlight ON. GP13 driven high = MOSFET on = LCD_BL near 0 V = backlight OFF. Enable polarity as seen by firmware is therefore inverted (active-low backlight).
